record_type_quote: Our goal in this study was to determine if we could replicate initial findings when providing the intervention, Un Abrazo Para La Familia (“Abrazo”).

targets.authors: Marshall, CA; Badger, TA; Curran, MA
targets.title: Un Abrazo Para la Familia: Providing low-income Hispanics with education and skills in coping with cancer and caregiving
targets.evidence_quote: The objective of the Portland replication was to train 20 promotoras to implement Abrazo in their communities with at least 120 Latino cancer survivors and co-survivors.
targets.outcome_quote: Portland promotoras demonstrated that when the Abrazo intervention is provided via a culturally congruent, accessible format, the significant gains in cancer knowledge and self-efficacy reported by underserved co-survivors can be replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that the Portland implementation replicated the prior Tucson gains in knowledge and self-efficacy.
